corrections.text: This article originally stated that "Socket's sandbox testing recorded reads from 51 separate credential stores." The sandbox run was performed by a third party, Bitbison, not by Socket. Socket's blog post states: "Bitbison's sandbox run confirms that the gem runs the payload at install time and reads credential files" and "Bitbison's sandbox recorded reads from 51 credential stores." The count of 51 credential stores is correct; only the attribution of which firm ran the sandbox test was wrong.
